portal.name: FLN
landing.heroTitle: Find out what each child actually knows — not just who passed.
landing.heroSubtitle: An open assessment platform for foundational numeracy. Teachers print a paper, children write on it, a phone camera scans it back in. What comes out is not a mark — it is the specific concept a child is stuck on, and what to do next.
landing.problem.title: Children clear the grade. The gap stays.
landing.problem.body: NEP 2020 named universal foundational literacy and numeracy the highest near-term priority for Indian schooling, and NIPUN Bharat set 2026–27 as the deadline. But a class test tells a teacher who scored low — not why. Two children can get the same 4 out of 10 for entirely different reasons, and need entirely different things next. That difference is what this platform is built to find.
landing.vision.title: Our Vision
landing.vision.body: Every child should leave the foundational years able to read with comprehension and handle number confidently. Getting there needs more than a pass mark: it needs to know, for each child, which concept is missing and what to put in front of them next.
landing.curriculum.title: How the curriculum is held
landing.curriculum.body: The syllabus is broken into individual concepts, each with its own prerequisites — and often more than one valid route into it. A diagnostic is generated against that map rather than against a grade label, which is how the system pinpoints the gap behind a wrong answer instead of simply recording it.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.step1Body: A paper per child, pitched at their current level. A new class with no history gets a standard grade-level paper.
landing.how.step2Body: Name-tagged worksheets per student, or one common paper for the whole class.
landing.how.step3Body: Children answer on paper. No device per child, and no connectivity needed in the classroom.
landing.how.step4Body: A phone camera or the school scanner sends the completed sheets back in.
landing.how.step5Body: Either the child clears the bar, or the system reports the level they are actually at.
landing.how.step6Body: A re-assessment is scheduled at that level, and the next paper is built from what just changed.
landing.usp.title: What makes this different
landing.usp.paperBody: No tablet per child and no assumption of reliable connectivity. A phone camera is the only hardware between the classroom and the data.
landing.usp.diagnosisBody: A wrong answer is traced back to the prerequisite concept behind it. Because a concept can have more than one route into it, two children with the same score can be told two different things.
landing.usp.auditableBody: AI helps generate and tag questions. It never decides pass or fail. An answer that does not match a known pattern stays unclassified until a person confirms it — the system will not invent a diagnosis it has not seen before.
landing.usp.openBody: The curriculum map, the question logic and the scoring rules are public. A state, a district or a researcher can read exactly how a child was assessed — and disagree with it in the open.
landing.audience.title: Who it is for
landing.audience.teachersBody: A class worth of papers in one click, and results without an evening of marking.
landing.audience.headsBody: Where the cohort actually stands, concept by concept rather than pass by pass.
landing.audience.statesBody: Assessment aligned to NIPUN Bharat Lakshyas, without standing up another parallel data silo.
landing.audience.researchBody: An open codebase and a curriculum framework that is meant to be argued with.
landing.cycle.title: The assessment year
landing.cycle.cycle1Description: Initial placement to identify each student's starting level.
landing.cycle.cycle2Description: Progress check to track growth and adjust remediation.
landing.cycle.cycle3Description: Final assessment to confirm outcomes for the year.
landing.scope.title: Where this stands today
landing.scope.subtitle: Numeracy first. This is a working build, not a finished product.
landing.scope.body: Mathematics only — nothing here assesses literacy yet, despite the name. The name states the problem the project is built to address in full; the build addresses one half of it so far. The current release covers the year before Class 1 through Class 3, and the curriculum framework behind it is public and still moving. We would rather tell you that than show you a finished-looking product.
landing.involve.title: Built in the open
landing.involve.body: Built by Vicharanashala — Lab for Education Design at IIT Ropar. The code, the curriculum framework and the open questions all live on GitHub. Issues, corrections and arguments about the pedagogy are welcome.
